subject: english
stem:
A girl tries several ways to wake up early and discovers that preparing at night helps most.
Which idea connects all the sentences?
options: A Better Start Begins at Night
The Only Way Anyone Can Wake Up

optionRationales.reason: A Better Start Begins at Night：抓住早起目標與前晚準備的關鍵發現。
The Red Alarm Clock：原文核心不是特定鬧鐘。
The Only Way Anyone Can Wake Up：一次個人經驗不能推出 only/anyone。
Sleeping through Every Morning：故事重點是改善起床。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「標題能指出全文核心而不劇透單一局部或誇大範圍」可推出 A Better Start Begins at Night；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 A Better Start Begins at Night 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
